deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page. Folio 60v of 'R.Varia' is page 8 of a printed lecture catalogue (Verzeichniss der Vorlesungen) of the Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Berlin. The previous page (7) carries Ohm, Grüson, Joachimsthal, Dirksen, Lejeune-Dirichlet and Encke, together with the start of 'Naturwissenschaften'. The next page (9) begins 'Geschichte und Geographie'.

This page has two parts:
(a) The end of the Naturwissenschaften section:
- Zoology: Troschel, Klug, Erichson.
- Histology: Schultz.
- Botany: Kunth, Link.
- Mineralogy: Weiß.
- Geognosy: G. Rose, Girard, Gumprecht.
- Palaeontology: J. Müller, Beyrich.
(b) The section 'Staats- Cameral- und Gewerbewissenschaften':
- v. Raumer, Riedel, W. Dieterici, Helwing, Dönniges, v. Henning, Störig, Magnus (Technologie), Rüst (Statik, Mechanik und Maschinenkunde).

The page gives only course titles, weekly hours and whether each course is privatim, öffentlich or unentgeltlich. There are no marginal annotations, calculations or handwriting by Riemann visible.

Dating: the faculty names and the Sunday botanical excursions suggest a semester during Riemann's Berlin study period (1847–1849), probably a summer semester. The previous page lists Dirichlet's number theory and 'Anwendung der Integralrechnung auf die Zahlenlehre', and Riemann is known to have attended Dirichlet's courses in Berlin. This dating is an inference of mine and is not verified.

The page's interest is purely biographical: it shows a course catalogue Riemann kept among his papers.

results.what: Printed Berlin university lecture catalogue page (natural sciences; state, cameral and trade sciences); no mathematical content

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a printed university course catalogue with no mathematical content and no visible annotations by Riemann. It has only minor biographical interest, documenting his Berlin student years (c. 1847–49).
transcription_corrections: The obscured line under 'Theoretische und praktische Botanik' is partly overprinted. It reads 'mit Demonstrationen, lehrt Hr. Prof. Link sechsmal wöchentlich von 7-8 Uhr privatim'. The '[?]' after 'sechsmal' is consistent with the visible traces, but the line is damaged.
'Weifs', 'Preufsische', 'Preufsischen' and 'Bedürfnifs' render the long s + s ligature (ß). They should read 'Weiß', 'Preußische', 'Preußischen' and 'Bedürfniß'.
'Stralthiere' is the period spelling (= Strahltiere) and is correctly transcribed from the print.
